create.name: Dr. Christine Page
create.bio:
Dr. Christine Page is a London-trained physician turned intuitive teacher and writer, who grew up in a family of healers and homeopaths and qualified in medicine at the University of London in 1978. After years combining conventional practice with homeopathy and spiritual counselling, she closed her practice in the mid-1990s to write and teach, and she has lived in the United States since 2001. Sometimes described as a mystical physician, she approaches life as a soul's journey towards wholeness, and is the author of ten books, among them The Healing Power of the Sacred Woman, The Heart of the Great Mother, Beyond the Obvious and The Magic of Mother Nature.

Much of her teaching centres on the sacred feminine. Her Women's Mysteries programme, built on her Handbook of Women's Mysteries, follows six lunar months of teachings, meditations and ritual on cycles, intuition and creative power, and graduates can certify as facilitators. She also gives astrological soul readings by phone or Zoom, longer spiritual supervision for people at a crossroads, and Spirit Mapping, a small-group seminar with her partner Leland Landry in which participants step into their own birth chart laid out on the floor. On her YouTube channel and Heartspeak podcast she reflects on astrology and the times, and films journeys to sacred places for her Earth Mysteries series.

courses.title: Women's Mysteries – Online Course
courses.description: A self-paced course over six lunar months, in six video 'gateways' with sixteen meditations, rituals and reflection exercises on women's cycles, intuition and creative energy. Includes access to a private online group.

courses.title: Women's Mysteries – Online Course & Certification
courses.description: The six-month online course with the extra requirements for certifying as a Women's Mysteries facilitator; certified graduates are listed in her Wise Women directory.

courses.title: Handbook of Women's Mysteries – Home Study
courses.description: The handbook as an e-book with eleven recorded meditations and practical exercises, for working through the teachings at home.

courses.title: Handbook of Women's Mysteries – Introduction (Audiobook)
courses.description: The handbook's 31 chapters as an audiobook, with five guided meditations and printable notes of rituals and questions.

courses.title: Soul Reading
courses.description: A 50-minute intuitive reading by phone or Zoom, drawing on your birth chart, about life purpose, gifts and inner obstacles. You receive a recording afterwards.

courses.title: Spiritual Supervision
courses.description: Four 50-minute sessions spread over several months, for people facing a major decision or a turning point who want steady spiritual support.
courses.price: $160 USD per session; $640 USD for 4 sessions

courses.title: Spirit Mapping
courses.description: A three-day astrology seminar for up to nine people, led with Leland Landry, in which each participant walks into their own birth chart laid out on the floor while the group plays its parts. Held where a host invites them.

free_resources.title: Heartspeak Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of talks on astrology, the times we live in and the soul's path, also streamed live on her YouTube channel.
